name: Okta Access Airlock
description: Governed Okta administration. Reads, plans, applies, and proves custody of every change against the Okta System Log.

credential_spec.name: Okta (OAuth service app, private key JWT)

commands.title: Verify connection
commands.description: Probe every granted OAuth scope and name each missing one alongside the commands it blocks.

commands.title: Rate limit headroom
commands.description: Report the remaining Okta rate limit headroom per endpoint bucket, so a bulk plan is never started that cannot finish.

commands.title: Find users
commands.description: Find users by Okta filter expression. Results from filter may feed a write. Results from search are marked advisory and may not, because Okta serves search from an eventually consistent datasource.

filter.label: Filter expression
filter.help: Okta filter, for example: status eq "ACTIVE". Defaults to active users.

search.label: Free text search
search.help: Eventually consistent. Marks the result advisory so it cannot feed an apply.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Get one user
commands.description: Profile, status and credential posture for a single user.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: List a user's access
commands.description: Groups, reachable applications and standing admin roles in one read. Application links are what the person can actually open, rather than what an assignment table implies.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: List live credentials
commands.description: OAuth grants, per client refresh tokens and enrolled devices, which are the things that survive a deactivation. Reports plainly that Okta exposes no way to enumerate active sessions.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: Find groups
commands.description: Find groups by filter, paged to completion, reporting whether the set is complete.

q.label: Name prefix
q.help: Match groups whose name starts with this.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Get group members
commands.description: Every member of one group, paged to completion so a set is never half reported.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Check rule entanglement
commands.description: Report whether removing a membership would also permanently modify a group rule. Okta adds a manually removed user to the rule's exception list, which affects every other member the rule governs and cannot be undone without suspending the rule org wide.

user_id.label: User id
user_id.help: The user whose membership would be removed.

group_id.label: Group id
group_id.help: The group they would be removed from.

commands.title: Explain access
commands.description: Why can this user reach this application? Direct assignment, or through which group, or through which rule. The question an access review exists to answer.

commands.title: Blast radius of a deactivation
commands.description: What this user loses on deactivation, and more importantly what survives it: group memberships, OAuth grants and refresh tokens all persist, and active sessions cannot be enumerated at all. Also names any group left with no owner.

commands.title: Plan a membership change
commands.description: Compute a group membership change without applying it, snapshot and fingerprint the state it depends on, and name every removal that would also permanently modify a group rule. Refuses to plan against a membership it could not read to completion.

add.label: Users to add
add.help: User ids to add. Already present users are reported as no ops.

remove.label: Users to remove
remove.help: User ids to remove. Non members are reported as no ops.

commands.title: Plan a deactivation
commands.description: Compute a deactivation with its full blast radius, snapshot and fingerprint the state it depends on, and recommend suspension instead where the change may need undoing. Nothing is written.

user_id.label: User id
user_id.help: The user to plan a deactivation for.

commands.title: Detect ungoverned changes
commands.description: Find access changes in the Okta System Log with no governed approval behind them. Reads Okta's own record rather than any record this module keeps. Reports what was visible as of a stated log watermark, and never claims that no ungoverned change occurred.

since.label: Since
since.help: ISO timestamp. Defaults to whatever the log returns.

max_events.help: Stop after this many log events and report the view as partial.

commands.title: Custody report for one target
commands.description: A custody timeline for one user or group with a verdict per change: governed, ungoverned, system originated or unproven. Every verdict is bounded by the log watermark it was computed against.

target_id.label: Target id
target_id.help: A user id or a group id.

commands.title: Apply a membership change
commands.description: Apply an approved membership change. Re reads the group, re hashes it, and refuses if anything moved since the plan was approved. Each add and removal reports landed, failed or unresolved separately; an unresolved outcome raises rather than being receipted as a completed action.

fingerprint.label: Approved fingerprint
fingerprint.help: From the matching plan command. The apply refuses if state moved since.

intent.label: Approved intent
intent.help: The intent block from the matching plan.

snapshot.label: Approved snapshot
snapshot.help: The snapshot from the plan, used to name what drifted.

commands.title: Suspend a user
commands.description: Suspend a user. The reversible alternative to deactivation and the one this module recommends where a change may need undoing. Sessions are ended and are not restored.

commands.title: Unsuspend a user
commands.description: Restore a suspended user to their previous state.

commands.title: Unlock a user
commands.description: Clear a lockout. Low risk and does not change any access.

commands.title: Deactivate a user
commands.description: Deactivate a user against an approved plan, refusing if their access changed since. Group memberships are unaffected by deactivation and revoked sessions are not restored, so the result states what survived rather than implying an off switch.

fingerprint.label: Approved fingerprint
fingerprint.help: From the matching plan command. The apply refuses if state moved since.

intent.label: Approved intent
intent.help: The intent block from the matching plan.

snapshot.label: Approved snapshot
snapshot.help: The snapshot from the plan, used to name what drifted.

commands.title: Revoke live credentials
commands.description: Revoke sessions, OAuth grants and per client refresh tokens, reporting each separately rather than as one success flag. Okta cannot enumerate sessions, so the session result reports that the revocation was accepted, not how many it ended.

commands.title: Describe the org
commands.description: Org posture built from what the assigned admin role can actually read: user counts by status, dormant and never signed in accounts, group and application counts, and whether group rules are reachable. Reports what it could not see rather than filling it in.

dormant_days.help: Days without a sign in before an account counts as dormant.

commands.title: Access review pack
commands.description: The standing access report an access review asks for: one row per person covering what they can open, which groups grant it, whether they hold standing admin, and how long since they last signed in. Says plainly where admin roles could not be read rather than reporting nobody holds admin.

filter.label: Population filter
filter.help: Okta filter expression. Defaults to active users.

commands.title: Blast radius of a group deletion
commands.description: If this group were deleted, exactly who loses which applications, and which group rules would be left pointing at a group that no longer exists. There is no delete command in this module; this exists so the consequence can be seen before somebody does it in the console.

commands.title: Audit evidence pack
commands.description: The evidence bundle, assembled entirely from Okta's own records rather than from anything this module asserts about itself. Carries the log watermark every statement is bounded by, and an explicit list of what the pack is not.

commands.title: Plan an MFA reset
commands.description: Plan a multifactor reset, treated as the account takeover vector it is rather than a routine support action. Between reset and re enrolment a password alone reaches the account, and the preview says so.

commands.title: Plan a full offboarding
commands.description: Plan an offboarding as three separately approved applies, ordered so nothing undoes a previous step: revoke live credentials, remove group memberships, then deactivate. Refuses when memberships cannot be read to completion, and names every removal that would also modify a group rule.

commands.title: List administrators
commands.description: Who holds administrative privilege, reconstructed by replaying privilege grant and revoke events from the System Log. Used because the roles API answers 403 for a read only administrator. Reports itself as a floor rather than a total: a grant older than the log retention window does not appear.

commands.title: Dormant administrators
commands.description: Who holds administrative privilege and has performed no administrative action in the window. Standing privilege nobody exercises is the finding an access review exists to produce, and it cannot be exported from anywhere because it needs role holders joined against activity over time.

dormant_days.help: Days without an administrative action before a standing admin counts as dormant.

commands.title: List enrolled factors
commands.description: A user's enrolled authenticators, which is exactly what an MFA reset destroys. Flags an account holding a single active factor, because resetting that leaves a password alone reaching the account until re enrolment.

commands.title: List group rules
commands.description: Every group rule and which groups it assigns into, with its exclusion list. A rule grants access without anybody approving each grant, so a review that never looks at rules has not looked at how most access is handed out.

commands.title: Plan a group sync
commands.description: Plan a group reconciled to an exact member list. Refuses when the membership cannot be read to completion, because a sync against a partial read removes people this module never saw. Warns loudly when a sync empties a group or removes more than half of it.

target_member_ids.label: Target members
target_member_ids.help: The exact list the group should contain. An empty list means empty the group, and must be given explicitly.

commands.title: Settle an unresolved write
commands.description: Settle a write whose outcome nobody could determine, using Okta's own log rather than a retry. An apply that gets no usable answer raises rather than guessing, which leaves a real question open; this answers it from evidence, so a retry never doubles a change that already landed.

target_id.label: Target id
target_id.help: The user or group the write was aimed at.

attempted_at.label: Attempted at
attempted_at.help: ISO timestamp from the unresolved failure.

expected_event_type.label: Expected event
expected_event_type.help: Narrow the search to one Okta event type.

commands.title: Reset enrolled factors
commands.description: Reset a user's authenticators against an approved plan, refusing if the enrolled set changed since approval because the set being wiped would not be the set that was reviewed. Not reversible: the enrolments are gone and the user must enrol again.

fingerprint.label: Approved fingerprint
fingerprint.help: From the matching plan. The apply refuses if state moved.

intent.label: Approved intent
intent.help: The intent block from the matching plan.

commands.title: Apply a group sync
commands.description: Reconcile a group to an approved member list, refusing if the group moved after approval because a sync applied to a moved group removes people nobody reviewed. Each add and removal reports landed, failed or unresolved separately.

fingerprint.label: Approved fingerprint
fingerprint.help: From the matching plan. The apply refuses if state moved.

intent.label: Approved intent
intent.help: The intent block from the matching plan.

commands.title: Offboard a user
commands.description: Run the three offboarding stages in order, reporting each separately: revoke live credentials, remove group memberships, then deactivate. Deactivation is last because it clears none of the others and doing it first would only make the rest look done.

fingerprint.label: Approved fingerprint
fingerprint.help: From the matching plan. The apply refuses if state moved.

intent.label: Approved intent
intent.help: The intent block from the matching plan.
